point_definition: Ground-contact vertex shared by the bag face toward the vehicle and the face toward the rectangle interior; not the top corner, silhouette extremum or floor reflection.
measurement_source: User reconfirmed yesterday's dimensions: near=1.20m and far=1.70m from rear axle center; left/right inner corners each 0.25m from centerline.

pixel_uncertainty_note: Illustrative sensitivity only, not an independently measured uncertainty bound or confidence interval.
intrinsics_status: Historical 2026-08-31 intrinsics retained only for loader compatibility; device association not independently verified; not new XWF intrinsic calibration.
limitations: Ground plane only. Pose, focus/lens, 640x480 native resolution and crop must remain unchanged. Outside the control quadrilateral is extrapolation. Lane following, VO, GPS and stopping accuracy require separate verification.
